mapper.update: UPDATE coupons SET coupon_name = #{couponName}, coupon_amount = #{couponAmount}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, remaining_quantity = #{remainingQuantity}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, redemption_code = #{redemptionCode}, status = #{status}, coupon_type = #{couponType}, min_order_amount = #{minOrderAmount} WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupons WHERE status = 1 AND remaining_quantity > 0 AND expire_time > NOW()

SELECT coupon_id, coupon_name, coupon_amount, total_quantity, remaining_quantity, expire_time, redemption_code, status, coupon_type, min_order_amount, create_time, update_time FROM coupons WHERE expire_time < NOW() ORDER BY expire_time DESC

SELECT coupon_id, coupon_name, coupon_amount, total_quantity, remaining_quantity, expire_time, redemption_code, status, coupon_type, min_order_amount, create_time, update_time FROM coupons WHERE redemption_code = #{redemptionCode}
